description:
Files:
- lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge/state.ex
- lib/zaq/channels/api.ex
- lib/zaq/channels/events.ex
- linked-device runtime owner

Functional specifications:
Use existing ingress status and focused retry dispatch. Track connector and attempt generation; distinguish QR/connected/disconnected/expired/failed, clear expired QR and ignore stale events. Return actual restart errors; control events never reach agent. Require trusted authorized operator context and redact credentials.
Architecture refinement: Common pairing events/status represent pending, connected, expired, disconnected and failed with connector and attempt generation. Provider translates native events and supplies QR/code payload and expiration evidence. QR is a presentation method, not an OAuth assumption.

Tests before implementation:
- QR expiry and refresh with controlled clock
- Stale attempt ignored
- A/B status isolation
- Restart error surfaced
- Unauthorized/nil actor denied
- Control events excluded from agent
- Exercise shared contract with a minimal fake second provider; keep WhatsApp-specific expectations in provider contract tests

Branches validated:
- unpaired
- pairing
- connected
- expired
- disconnected
- retry failure
- forbidden

Documentation:
- Channels status/retry contract
- operator pairing recovery

Action reuse assessment:
Extend existing channel_ingress_status and runtime restart APIs. Local authenticated process/session management; agent/workflow exposure inappropriate. Registry/workflow Actions/Channels events search found no pairing Action. Reuse archive_channel_connector for archival; do not duplicate config/archive operations. Exact config and actor in; bounded status/error out via explicit NodeRouter Events. Inspect and reuse existing device-connection behavior before adding shared modules; document any missing contract as a prerequisite. No duplicate provider-specific credential store or pairing framework.

Validation:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle; tests before implementation, focused checks per issue, final gate before approval. No live account connection or send without scoped authorization.

Mocking:
External Amarula transport only; use real internal boundaries and isolated DB/process/storage fixtures; inject config and clock without global mutation.

Policy:
Recheck module responsibilities, docs/services/channels.md, Action reuse, system-config and testing guidance before coding. BO calls use explicit NodeRouter Events; nil actor never grants permission.

comments.text: Implemented generic Pairing reducer and owner-owned attempt generation/QR expiry/status. Provider translation for WhatsApp, native control excluded from chat handlers. Exact connector status/retry authorize confidential super-admin actor; disabled/forged config rejected; actual restart result retained. Socket open required for connected; adoption queries actual Amarula state. OAuth device branch inspected earlier: HTTP code polling behavior is incompatible with socket QR lifecycle, canonical Credential reused instead. mix q and 123 tests/2 properties pass including expiry, stale attempts, account isolation, owner replacement, unauthorized/nil actor and actual retry error.

title: [zaq-0l7.5] Normalize shared linked-device pairing status and retry
